responsibility: Contains the IQ2000 machine description that maps GCC RTL to target instructions. It defines UNSPEC codes, instruction attributes such as type, mode, length, CPU, delay-slot properties, the delay-slot automaton and branch-likely behavior, and the actual define_insn/expand patterns for arithmetic, control flow, moves, special-purpose operations, and IQ2000 builtins, making it the main recognizer/output specification that drives instruction selection and assembly emission for this target.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative machine-description file for IQ2000 instruction selection and scheduling: it defines UNSPEC codes, insn attributes, delay-slot rules, and define_insn/expand RTL patterns for the architecture’s operations and builtins. Unlike iq2000.cc, it is not the procedural target-hook implementation; unlike iq2000.h, it is not the macro header for ABI and register/layout policy; unlike iq2000.opt, it does not define option parsing tables.
